faq.q: how much area does one litre of emulsion cover
faq.a: Our interior emulsion covers about 120 sq ft per litre for 2 coats. Exterior emulsion covers about 100 sq ft per litre.
Exterior WeatherShield has a 7-year warranty and roof waterproofing has a 5-year warranty.

faq.q: do you deliver, how long does delivery take
faq.a: Yes! Delivery within Chennai takes 2 days. Other cities in Tamil Nadu take 3-5 days.

faq.q: can you match my colour or shade
faq.a: Yes, any shade from our shade card can be tinted at your nearest dealer, and we offer a free colour consultation visit.

faq.q: how much putty do i need
faq.a: Wall putty covers about 15 sq ft per kg for 2 coats. A 40kg bag covers roughly 600 sq ft.
We're available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM. This assistant replies any time.
